definitions.gloss: poor result, badly done, poor quality
definitions.explanation: A result or product that is below expectations or standards. Can refer to poor performance, bad harvest, or substandard work.

examples.japanese: {今年|ことし}は{米|こめ}が{不出来|ふでき}だった。
examples.english: The rice harvest was poor this year.

examples.japanese: {不出来|ふでき}な{息子|むすこ}ですが、よろしくお{願|ねが}いします。
examples.english: He is my unaccomplished son, but please look after him.
examples.notes: Humble expression when introducing one's child

examples.japanese: この{作品|さくひん}は{不出来|ふでき}で、{自分|じぶん}でも{納得|なっとく}していない。
examples.english: This work turned out poorly, and even I'm not satisfied with it.

notes:
{不出来|ふでき} combines the negative prefix {不|ふ} with {出来|でき} (result, quality). It describes something that turned out poorly or below standard.

USAGE:
1. Poor harvest or crop: {今年|ことし}の{米|こめ}は{不出来|ふでき}だ (this year's rice is poor)
2. Substandard work: {不出来|ふでき}な{作品|さくひん} (a poorly made work)
3. Humble reference to one's child: {不出来|ふでき}な{息子|むすこ}ですが... (my unaccomplished son...) — a set humble expression

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {不出来|ふでき}な + noun: poorly done ~
- {不出来|ふでき}に{終|お}わる: to end in a poor result

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {上出来|じょうでき}: well done, excellent result
- {出来|でき}がいい/{悪|わる}い: good/bad quality (more neutral phrasing)
